item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-8a41d6ceda2bfd48","start_unit":5,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Destatis reported that the overall monetary-at-risk-of-poverty rate was 14.4% in 2023; the rate was 26.4% for people living alone and 23.7% for single-parent households.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.10"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The 2023 survey year falls within the target period; the income reference year is the preceding year.","ruler_attribution":"Population outcome during the federal government led by Olaf Scholz; the source does not establish causal responsibility.","limitations":["The table reports poverty-risk incidence, not the effect of a specific Scholz policy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b8fa83140dce9a2f","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The federal budget dashboard reports €111.6 billion in federal transfers to the pension insurance system in 2023 and a federal debt ratio of 62.3% of GDP in 2023.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.6","6B.1","6B.9"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Both figures are reported for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"These are federal-government fiscal outcomes during Scholz's chancellorship; the source does not attribute the figures specifically to Scholz.","limitations":["The extract does not identify the policy decisions, budget composition, or causal contribution of the Chancellor."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b8fa83140dce9a2f","start_unit":4,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The federal budget dashboard reports €37.73 billion in credit-market interest expenditure and €48.21 billion in labor-market-policy expenditure for 2023.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.6","5B.9","6B.2"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Both figures are reported for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"These are federal-budget outcomes during Scholz's chancellorship; the source does not establish that Scholz personally selected or caused the amounts.","limitations":["The extract does not provide execution quality, distributional effects, or comparison with the government's stated targets."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7671b188e4b2d68c","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"On 28 August 2023, Diakonie said the coalition's proposed €2.4 billion child basic-security package would not create an anti-poverty child benefit, because the subsistence minimum remained too low and its calculation was not systematically reviewed.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.5","6B.10","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The assessment concerns the coalition proposal presented in August 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The criticism concerns the Scholz-led coalition's compromise; Diakonie is an external civil-society evaluator, not evidence of Scholz's personal intent.","limitations":["This is an advocacy organization's assessment and does not establish final enacted-law outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e8aebf4518183110","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Audit reported that the citizen's benefit law entering into force on 1 January 2023 was expected to increase expenditure by approximately €4.8 billion in 2023, including €4.2 billion for the federal government; it warned that the two-year asset and housing grace period, high exemption levels, and six-month suspension of sanctions could create abuse, deadweight, and labor-market risks.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.7","5B.9","6B.2","6B.5","6B.7","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The audit concerns legislation implemented in 2023, though the report was issued in November 2022.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern a federal law adopted under the Scholz government; the audit does not attribute each design choice personally to Scholz.","limitations":["The extract records projected risks and recommendations, not verified realized effects in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3ecee0fd8d3ffb7a","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The ifo Institute's spring 2023 forecast projected that German GDP would decline by 0.1% in 2023 and average inflation would be 6.2%, with high inflation reducing purchasing power and substantially increasing financing costs.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The forecast was published in 2023 and specifically covers the 2023 economic outlook.","ruler_attribution":"The forecast describes Germany's macroeconomic environment during Scholz's chancellorship; it does not establish government causation.","limitations":["This is a forecast rather than an observed end-of-year result and does not evaluate specific government measures."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e9d41c8931a2a2f2","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The Federal Criminal Police Office reported that registered violent offenses against police officers increased by 3,128 to 42,777 in 2022, up 7.9%, while 96,208 officers were victims, up 8.6%; both were record highs. It also recorded 37 homicide offenses, including one completed case with two victims.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.6","3B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report was published in November 2023 but covers 2022, preceding most of the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The figures describe Germany's security baseline during the Scholz government but do not establish Scholz's responsibility or a 2023 policy response.","limitations":["The source concerns violence against police rather than overall population safety and reports 2022 data."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-b1e293585993cc9b","SRC-d8e400fa6758b9ef","SRC-a1fa6d6a7ac32941","SRC-86b047dd98029efa","SRC-791641be03002077","SRC-bb016614a439f4b1"],"batch_limitations":["Several documents were general landing pages, archives, or institutional descriptions without a concrete 2023 event, policy, quantitative result, or finding materially attributable to Olaf Scholz.","The supplied evidence generally describes federal-government or Germany-wide conditions and does not by itself establish Olaf Scholz's personal causation, intent, or implementation responsibility."]}
